name: Mark Bagnall
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Mark Bagnall as an author of “Measured works: Surveyors' views of early European settlement in Wellington”.
Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Mark Bagnall as an author of “Visualising Wellington's streets”.
